status: frozen before any E1 feature was encoded
purpose: post-hoc encoder-transfer extension; the S and D results were already known when this encoder was added, so this is exploratory and must not be reported as a pre-specified confirmation

encoder.weights_provenance: torch.hub checkpoint of the official DINO release, deit_small, 300 epochs; already on disk, no download
encoder.frozen: eval mode, requires_grad_(False), no training, no fine-tuning

features.extracted: the final patch-token sequence (class token dropped)
features.downsample_to_B_canvas: the encoder's own patch-8 token grid (canvas/8) is mapped onto B's canvas grid with F.interpolate(bilinear, align_corners=False)
features.canvas_adjustment: B's canvas is additionally resized to the nearest multiple of 8 on both axes so that the patch-8 token grid is exact; the change is < 1 % of either extent and is applied identically to every image
features.positional_embedding_handling: pos_embed is resampled from the checkpoint's 28x28 grid to the actual token grid by timm (dynamic_img_size, bicubic+antialias)
features.normalisation: L2 per spatial position, after concatenation

input_geometry.base_canvas: smaller edge to 448, aspect preserved, top-left crop to a multiple of 14 (B's canvas, identical extent)
input_geometry.note: the geometry is B's canvas; the colour rule is the encoder's own ImageNet rule.  No encoder-specific tuning, PCA, coreset or foreground selection.

methods.TRI_E_J: B=1/3, E=1/3, C=1/3, shared reference row
methods.TRI_E_L: B=1/3, E=1/3, C=1/3, independent reference rows
methods.BAL_E_J: B=1/4, E=1/4, C=1/2, shared reference row
methods.BAL_E_L: B=1/4, E=1/4, C=1/2, independent reference rows
methods.controls: A1 (B=.5,C=.5) and DUP (B=1/3,Bcopy=1/3,C=1/3) re-scored in this run

btad_geometry: the coordinate-correct C re-grid and the image-faithful ground truth (the S0 primary revision); the study revision is kept as a labelled sensitivity row

statistics.aggregation: interaction inside each bootstrap replicate, averaged over the conditions, then percentile

caveats: the test data has been used before; this is an encoder-transfer check
the branch was chosen after the S and D results were known
